title: GlomeHomeTour trajectory.csv row
description: One row of mobile/android's DatasetWriter trajectory.csv, promoted from DatasetFormat.trajectoryLine()/TRAJECTORY_HEADER. The CSV header string itself is the version marker for this format (see shared/schemas §2) -- there is no schema_version property because a CSV row has no JSON envelope to carry one; validate.py checks the header line against DatasetFormat.TRAJECTORY_HEADER verbatim instead.
